patch_description:
Replace the clipped-ring construction with a constrained nonlinear optimization initialized from a dense, staggered hexagonal arrangement.  The optimization treats all center coordinates and all 26 radii as variables, maximizing the radius sum subject directly to border and pairwise non-overlap constraints.  This is substantially better suited to the varying-radius, boundary-dominated square packing problem than assigning radii greedily after fixing centers.

The staggered six-layer seed is feasible and has good hexagonal local structure.  SLSQP can then move boundary circles, break symmetry, and redistribute radius to obtain a significantly larger sum.  Analytic constraint derivatives improve reliability and runtime.  A final tiny radius safety scaling protects against floating-point constraint tolerances.  A valid deterministic fallback remains available if SciPy is unavailable.
